question.am: በ50 ተማሪዎች ክፍል ውስጥ 30 ሒሳብ፣ 25 እንግሊዝኛ ይወዳሉ፤ 10 ሁለቱንም ይወዳሉ። አንዳቸውንም ትምህርት የማይወዱ ስንት ናቸው?

tip.en: Find $n(M \cup E)$ first, then subtract from 50.
tip.am: መጀመሪያ $n(M \cup E)$ን ፈልጉ፣ ከዚያ ከ50 ቀንሱ።

asks.en: How many students are outside both circles?
asks.am: ከሁለቱም ክበቦች ውጭ ስንት ተማሪዎች አሉ?

rule.en: Neither $= n(U) - n(M \cup E)$, and $n(M \cup E) = n(M) + n(E) - n(M \cap E)$.
rule.am: አንዳቸውም $= n(U) - n(M \cup E)$፣ እና $n(M \cup E) = n(M) + n(E) - n(M \cap E)$።

mistake.en: Doing $50 - 30 - 25 < 0$. The 10 who like both must be added back.
mistake.am: $50 - 30 - 25 < 0$ ማድረግ። ሁለቱንም የሚወዱት 10 መልሰው መደመር አለባቸው።

text.en: At least one subject: $30 + 25 - 10 = 45$ → $n(M \cup E) = 45$

why.en: The 10 who like both were counted twice.
why.am: ሁለቱንም የሚወዱት 10 ሁለት ጊዜ ተቆጥረዋል።

text.en: Neither $= 50 - 45 = 5$

why.en: Everyone else is outside both circles.
why.am: የቀሩት ሁሉ ከሁለቱም ክበቦች ውጭ ናቸው።

question.en: Out of 100 students: 45 study Geography (G), 40 History (H), 35 Mathematics (M); 15 study G and H, 10 study G and M, 12 study H and M, and 5 study all three. (i) How many study at least one subject? (ii) None? (iii) Only Geography?
question.am: ከ100 ተማሪዎች፦ 45 ጂኦግራፊ (G)፣ 40 ታሪክ (H)፣ 35 ሒሳብ (M) ያጠናሉ፤ 15 G እና H፣ 10 G እና M፣ 12 H እና M፣ 5 ደግሞ ሦስቱንም ያጠናሉ። (i) ቢያንስ አንድ ትምህርት የሚያጠኑ ስንት ናቸው? (ii) ምንም? (iii) ጂኦግራፊን ብቻ?

tip.en: Start from the centre (all three = 5) and work outwards in the Venn diagram.
tip.am: ከመሃሉ (ሦስቱም = 5) ጀምሩና በቬን ዲያግራሙ ወደ ውጭ ሂዱ።

hints.en: Use the 3-set formula: add singles, subtract pairs, add the triple.
hints.am: የ3 ስብስብ ቀመሩን ተጠቀሙ፦ ነጠላዎቹን ደምሩ፣ ጥንዶቹን ቀንሱ፣ ሦስቱን መልሳችሁ ደምሩ።

asks.en: Three numbers: at least one subject, no subject, Geography only.
asks.am: ሦስት ቁጥሮች፦ ቢያንስ አንድ ትምህርት፣ ምንም ትምህርት፣ ጂኦግራፊ ብቻ።

rule.en: 3-set formula: add the singles, subtract the pairs, add back the triple (it was subtracted one time too many).
rule.am: የ3 ስብስብ ቀመር፦ ነጠላዎቹን ደምሩ፣ ጥንዶቹን ቀንሱ፣ ሦስቱን መልሳችሁ ደምሩ (አንድ ጊዜ በላይ ተቀንሶ ነበርና)።

mistake.en: Forgetting to add the 5 back. Then the answer is 83, which is too small.
mistake.am: 5ን መልሶ መደመር መርሳት። ያኔ መልሱ 83 ይሆናል፤ ይህም በጣም ያንሳል።

text.en: Add the singles: $45 + 40 + 35 = 120$

why.en: Students in two or three subjects are counted more than once here.
why.am: እዚህ በሁለት ወይም በሦስት ትምህርቶች ያሉ ተማሪዎች ከአንድ ጊዜ በላይ ይቆጠራሉ።

text.en: Subtract the pairs: $120 - 15 - 10 - 12 = 83$

why.en: Each pair was counted twice; take one copy away.
why.am: እያንዳንዱ ጥንድ ሁለት ጊዜ ተቆጥሯል፤ አንዱን ቅጂ አስወግዱ።

text.en: Add back the triple: $83 + 5 = 88$

why.en: The 5 in the centre were added 3 times and subtracted 3 times, so add them once.
why.am: መሃል ያሉት 5 3 ጊዜ ተደምረው 3 ጊዜ ተቀንሰዋል፤ ስለዚህ አንድ ጊዜ ደምሯቸው።

why.en: Everyone outside all three circles.
why.am: ከሦስቱም ክበቦች ውጭ ያሉ ሁሉ።

why.en: Remove both pairs with G, then add back the 5 that were removed twice.
why.am: ከG ጋር ያሉትን ሁለቱንም ጥንዶች አስወግዱ፣ ከዚያ ሁለት ጊዜ የተወገዱትን 5 መልሳችሁ ደምሩ።

question.en: $A = \{x \in \mathbb{Z} \mid -2 \le x \le 2\}$ and $B = \{x \in \mathbb{N} \mid x < 4\}$. Find $A \cap B$, $A \setminus B$ and $B \setminus A$.
question.am: $A = \{x \in \mathbb{Z} \mid -2 \le x \le 2\}$ እና $B = \{x \in \mathbb{N} \mid x < 4\}$። $A \cap B$፣ $A \setminus B$ እና $B \setminus A$ን ፈልጉ።

tip.en: List both sets first. Remember: $\mathbb{N}$ starts at 1.
tip.am: መጀመሪያ ሁለቱንም ስብስቦች ዘርዝሩ። አስታውሱ፦ $\mathbb{N}$ ከ1 ይጀምራል።

asks.en: List A and B, then find three sets: both, A only, B only.
asks.am: Aን እና Bን ዘርዝሩ፣ ከዚያ ሦስት ስብስቦችን ፈልጉ፦ በሁለቱም፣ A ብቻ፣ B ብቻ።

known.en: A = integers from $-2$ to $2$; B = natural numbers less than 4
known.am: A = ከ$-2$ እስከ $2$ ያሉ ኢንቲጀሮች፤ B = ከ4 ያነሱ የተፈጥሮ ቁጥሮች

rule.en: $\le$ includes the end; $<$ does not. $\mathbb{N} = \{1, 2, 3, \dots\}$ has no 0.
rule.am: $\le$ ጫፉን ያካትታል፤ $<$ አያካትትም። $\mathbb{N} = \{1, 2, 3, \dots\}$ 0 የለውም።

mistake.en: Putting 0 in B. 0 is not a natural number, so 0 is in A only.
mistake.am: 0ን በB ውስጥ ማስገባት። 0 የተፈጥሮ ቁጥር አይደለም፤ ስለዚህ 0 በA ብቻ ውስጥ ነው።

why.en: $\le$ includes $-2$ and $2$; $x < 4$ stops B at 3.
why.am: $\le$ $-2$ እና $2$ን ያካትታል፤ $x < 4$ Bን በ3 ያቆመዋል።

text.en: In both: 1 and 2 → $A \cap B = \{1, 2\}$

why.en: Go through B: 1 ✓, 2 ✓, 3 is not in A.
why.am: Bን ተመልከቱ፦ 1 ✓፣ 2 ✓፣ 3 በA የለም።

text.en: From A cross out 1 and 2 → $A \setminus B = \{-2, -1, 0\}$

why.en: They are in B.
why.am: በB ውስጥ ናቸው።

text.en: From B cross out 1 and 2 → $B \setminus A = \{3\}$

why.en: They are in A.
why.am: በA ውስጥ ናቸው።

question.en: True or false? (i) $\emptyset \subset \{0\}$ (ii) $0 \in \emptyset$ (iii) $\{0\} = \emptyset$
question.am: እውነት ወይስ ሐሰት? (i) $\emptyset \subset \{0\}$ (ii) $0 \in \emptyset$ (iii) $\{0\} = \emptyset$

tip.en: $\emptyset$ has NO elements, but $\{0\}$ has one element: the number 0.
tip.am: $\emptyset$ ምንም አባል የለውም፤ $\{0\}$ ግን አንድ አባል አለው፦ ቁጥሩ 0።

hints.en: The empty set is a subset of every set.
hints.am: ባዶ ስብስብ የሁሉም ስብስብ ንዑስ ስብስብ ነው።

hints.en: Can anything be an element of a set with no elements?
hints.am: ምንም አባል በሌለው ስብስብ ውስጥ አንድ ነገር አባል ሊሆን ይችላል?

asks.en: Decide true or false for three statements about the empty set.
asks.am: ስለ ባዶ ስብስብ ለሦስት አባባሎች እውነት ወይም ሐሰት ወስኑ።

rule.en: $\emptyset$ (empty set) has no elements and is a subset of every set. $\{0\}$ is NOT empty: it holds the number 0.
rule.am: $\emptyset$ (ባዶ ስብስብ) ምንም አባል የለውም፤ የሁሉም ስብስብ ንዑስ ስብስብ ነው። $\{0\}$ ባዶ አይደለም፦ ቁጥሩን 0 ይይዛል።

mistake.en: Thinking $\{0\}$ is empty because 0 means "nothing". 0 is a number, and $\{0\}$ has it inside.
mistake.am: 0 "ምንም" ማለት ስለሆነ $\{0\}$ ባዶ ነው ብሎ ማሰብ። 0 ቁጥር ነው፤ $\{0\}$ ደግሞ በውስጡ ይዞታል።

text.en: (i) $\emptyset \subseteq \{0\}$ (empty set is in every set) and $\emptyset \ne \{0\}$ → proper subset → TRUE
text.am: (i) $\emptyset \subseteq \{0\}$ (ባዶ ስብስብ በሁሉም ስብስብ ውስጥ አለ) እና $\emptyset \ne \{0\}$ → ትክክለኛ ንዑስ ስብስብ → እውነት

why.en: $\{0\}$ has the extra element 0, so the subset is proper.
why.am: $\{0\}$ ተጨማሪ አባል 0 አለው፤ ስለዚህ ንዑስ ስብስቡ ትክክለኛ ነው።

text.en: (ii) $\emptyset$ has no elements, so 0 can't be in it → FALSE
text.am: (ii) $\emptyset$ ምንም አባል የለውም፤ ስለዚህ 0 በውስጡ ሊሆን አይችልም → ሐሰት

why.en: Nothing is an element of the empty set.
why.am: ምንም ነገር የባዶ ስብስብ አባል አይደለም።

text.en: (iii) $\{0\}$ has 1 element, $\emptyset$ has 0 elements → FALSE

why.en: Sets with different elements are not equal.
why.am: የተለያዩ አባላት ያሏቸው ስብስቦች እኩል አይደሉም።

title.en: Quiz: Sets and Operations on Sets
title.am: ፈተና፦ ስብስቦችና በስብስቦች ላይ የሚደረጉ ስሌቶች

description.en: 28 exam-style questions: multiple choice, set answers, numbers and Venn shading.
description.am: 28 የፈተና ዓይነት ጥያቄዎች፦ ምርጫ፣ የስብስብ መልሶች፣ ቁጥሮችና የቬን ማጥለል።

question.en: Which collection is a well-defined set?
question.am: የትኛው ስብስብ በግልጽ የተወሰነ ነው?

explanation.en: "Natural numbers less than 5" is well-defined: it is exactly {1, 2, 3, 4}.
explanation.am: "ከ5 ያነሱ የተፈጥሮ ቁጥሮች" በግልጽ የተወሰነ ነው፦ በትክክል {1, 2, 3, 4} ነው።

text.en: Look for opinion words: beautiful, good, tall. People can disagree about them.
text.am: የአስተያየት ቃላትን ፈልጉ፦ ውብ፣ ጎበዝ፣ ረጅም። ሰዎች በእነሱ ላይ ላይስማሙ ይችላሉ።

text.en: "Natural numbers less than 5" has no opinion: it is exactly $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$.
text.am: "ከ5 ያነሱ የተፈጥሮ ቁጥሮች" ምንም አስተያየት የለውም፦ በትክክል $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$ ነው።

rule.en: A set must be well-defined: for any object we can clearly say if it is in or out.
rule.am: ስብስብ በግልጽ የተወሰነ መሆን አለበት፦ ለማንኛውም ነገር ውስጥ መሆኑን ወይም አለመሆኑን በግልጽ መናገር አለብን።

wrong.en: a) "Beautiful cities": beautiful depends on the person.
wrong.am: a) "ውብ ከተሞች"፦ ውበት በሰው ይለያያል።

wrong.en: c) "Good students": good depends on opinion.
wrong.am: c) "ጎበዝ ተማሪዎች"፦ ጎበዝነት በአስተያየት ይለያያል።

wrong.en: d) "Tall people": how tall is tall? People disagree.
wrong.am: d) "ረጃጅም ሰዎች"፦ ምን ያህል ቢረዝም ነው ረጅም የሚባለው? ሰዎች አይስማሙም።

mistake.en: Choosing a group that sounds clear but uses an opinion word (beautiful, good, tall).
mistake.am: ግልጽ የሚመስል ግን የአስተያየት ቃል (ውብ፣ ጎበዝ፣ ረጅም) የሚጠቀም ቡድን መምረጥ።

question.en: Which statement is correct for $A = \{1, 2, 3\}$?
question.am: ለ$A = \{1, 2, 3\}$ የትኛው ዓረፍተ ነገር ትክክል ነው?

explanation.en: $2 \in A$: 2 is an element, and "$\in$" links an element to a set.
explanation.am: $2 \in A$፦ 2 አባል ነው፤ "$\in$" ደግሞ አባልን ከስብስብ ጋር ያገናኛል።

text.en: 2 is a single element, so it goes with $\in$: $2 \in A$ ✓
text.am: 2 ነጠላ አባል ነው፤ ስለዚህ ከ$\in$ ጋር ይሄዳል፦ $2 \in A$ ✓

text.en: $\{2\}$ is a set, so it goes with $\subseteq$: $\{2\} \subseteq A$ (not $\in$).
text.am: $\{2\}$ ስብስብ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ከ$\subseteq$ ጋር ይሄዳል፦ $\{2\} \subseteq A$ ($\in$ አይደለም)።

rule.en: $\in$ = "is an element of" (element → set). $\subseteq$ = "is a subset of" (set → set).
rule.am: $\in$ = "አባል ነው" (አባል → ስብስብ)። $\subseteq$ = "ንዑስ ስብስብ ነው" (ስብስብ → ስብስብ)።

wrong.en: a) $2 \subseteq A$: 2 is a number, not a set, so it can't be a subset.
wrong.am: a) $2 \subseteq A$፦ 2 ቁጥር ነው እንጂ ስብስብ አይደለም፤ ስለዚህ ንዑስ ስብስብ ሊሆን አይችልም።

wrong.en: b) $\{2\} \in A$: the elements of A are 1, 2, 3, not the set $\{2\}$.
wrong.am: b) $\{2\} \in A$፦ የA አባላት 1፣ 2፣ 3 ናቸው እንጂ ስብስቡ $\{2\}$ አይደለም።

wrong.en: d) $\{2\} \notin A$ happens to be true here, but "always" is wrong: for $A = \{\{2\}\}$ it is false. The clear, correct statement is $2 \in A$.
wrong.am: d) $\{2\} \notin A$ እዚህ እውነት ነው፤ "ሁልጊዜ" ግን ስሕተት ነው፦ ለ$A = \{\{2\}\}$ ሐሰት ነው። ግልጹና ትክክለኛው አባባል $2 \in A$ ነው።

mistake.en: Mixing up $\in$ and $\subseteq$. Number → $\in$; set in curly brackets → $\subseteq$.
mistake.am: $\in$ን እና $\subseteq$ን ማደባለቅ። ቁጥር → $\in$፤ በጥምዝ ቅንፍ ያለ ስብስብ → $\subseteq$።

question.en: $\{x \mid x \in \mathbb{N} \text{ and } x \le 4\}$ written by complete listing is:
question.am: $\{x \mid x \in \mathbb{N} \text{ and } x \le 4\}$ በሙሉ ዝርዝር ሲጻፍ፦

explanation.en: $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$: natural numbers start at 1, and $\le 4$ includes 4.
explanation.am: $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$፦ የተፈጥሮ ቁጥሮች ከ1 ይጀምራሉ፤ $\le 4$ ደግሞ 4ን ያካትታል።

text.en: Start at the first natural number: 1 (no 0).
Go up to 4, and include 4 because of $\le$ → $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$

rule.en: $\mathbb{N} = \{1, 2, 3, \dots\}$ (no 0). $\le$ means the end IS included.
rule.am: $\mathbb{N} = \{1, 2, 3, \dots\}$ (0 የለም)። $\le$ ማለት ጫፉ ይካተታል።

wrong.en: a) $\{0, 1, 2, 3, 4\}$: 0 is not a natural number.
wrong.am: a) $\{0, 1, 2, 3, 4\}$፦ 0 የተፈጥሮ ቁጥር አይደለም።

wrong.en: d) $\{0, 1, 2, 3\}$: has 0 and misses 4.

mistake.en: Starting $\mathbb{N}$ at 0. That is $\mathbb{W}$ (whole numbers).
mistake.am: $\mathbb{N}$ን ከ0 መጀመር። ያ $\mathbb{W}$ (ሙሉ ቁጥሮች) ነው።

question.en: Which number is NOT a rational number?
question.am: ምክንያታዊ ቁጥር ያልሆነው የትኛው ነው?

explanation.en: $\sqrt{2}$ is irrational: it can NOT be written as a fraction.
explanation.am: $\sqrt{2}$ ኢራሽናል ነው፦ እንደ ክፍልፋይ ሊጻፍ አይችልም።

text.en: Try to write each as a fraction: $0.5 = \frac12$, $-7 = \frac{-7}{1}$, $\frac34$ ✓
$\sqrt2 = 1.41421\dots$ never ends and never repeats → no fraction → irrational
text.am: $\sqrt2 = 1.41421\dots$ በፍጹም አያልቅም፣ አይደጋገምም → ክፍልፋይ የለውም → ኢራሽናል

rule.en: Rational = can be written as a fraction $\frac{a}{b}$ of integers ($b \ne 0$).
rule.am: ራሽናል = እንደ ኢንቲጀሮች ክፍልፋይ $\frac{a}{b}$ ($b \ne 0$) ሊጻፍ የሚችል።

wrong.en: a) $0.5 = \frac{1}{2}$: a fraction, so rational.
wrong.am: a) $0.5 = \frac{1}{2}$፦ ክፍልፋይ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ራሽናል።

wrong.en: b) $-7 = \frac{-7}{1}$: a fraction, so rational.
wrong.am: b) $-7 = \frac{-7}{1}$፦ ክፍልፋይ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ራሽናል።

wrong.en: d) $\frac{3}{4}$ is already a fraction.
wrong.am: d) $\frac{3}{4}$ ቀድሞውንም ክፍልፋይ ነው።

mistake.en: Thinking negative numbers or decimals are not rational. $-7$ and $0.5$ ARE rational.
mistake.am: አሉታዊ ቁጥሮች ወይም አስርዮሽ ራሽናል አይደሉም ብሎ ማሰብ። $-7$ እና $0.5$ ራሽናል ናቸው።

question.en: If $n(A) = 4$, the number of subsets of A is:
question.am: $n(A) = 4$ ከሆነ የA ንዑስ ስብስቦች ብዛት፦

explanation.en: $2^4 = 16$ subsets.
explanation.am: $2^4 = 16$ ንዑስ ስብስቦች።

text.en: Use subsets $= 2^n$ with $n = 4$.
$2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 = 16$

rule.en: Each element is "in" or "out" of a subset, so $n$ elements give $2^n$ subsets.
rule.am: እያንዳንዱ አባል በንዑስ ስብስቡ "ውስጥ" ወይም "ውጭ" ነው፤ ስለዚህ $n$ አባላት $2^n$ ንዑስ ስብስቦች ይሰጣሉ።

wrong.en: a) 4: that is only the number of elements.
wrong.am: a) 4፦ ያ የአባላቱ ቁጥር ብቻ ነው።

wrong.en: b) 8 $= 2 \times 4$: we multiply 2 by itself 4 times, not 2 times 4.
wrong.am: b) 8 $= 2 \times 4$፦ 2ን በራሱ 4 ጊዜ እናባዛለን እንጂ 2 ጊዜ 4 አይደለም።

wrong.en: c) 15 $= 2^4 - 1$ is the number of PROPER subsets.
wrong.am: c) 15 $= 2^4 - 1$ የትክክለኛ ንዑስ ስብስቦች ቁጥር ነው።

mistake.en: Calculating $2 \times 4$ instead of $2^4$.
mistake.am: በ$2^4$ ፈንታ $2 \times 4$ን ማስላት።

question.en: If $n(A) = 3$, the number of proper subsets of A is:
question.am: $n(A) = 3$ ከሆነ የA ትክክለኛ ንዑስ ስብስቦች ብዛት፦

explanation.en: $2^3 - 1 = 7$ proper subsets.
explanation.am: $2^3 - 1 = 7$ ትክክለኛ ንዑስ ስብስቦች።

text.en: All subsets: $2^3 = 8$
Remove the set itself: $8 - 1 = 7$

rule.en: Proper subsets = all subsets except the set itself: $2^n - 1$.
rule.am: ትክክለኛ ንዑስ ስብስቦች = ከራሱ ከስብስቡ በስተቀር ሁሉም ንዑስ ስብስቦች፦ $2^n - 1$።

wrong.en: a) 3: that is the number of elements.
wrong.am: a) 3፦ ያ የአባላቱ ቁጥር ነው።

wrong.en: b) 6 $= 2 \times 3$: not a power of 2.
wrong.am: b) 6 $= 2 \times 3$፦ የ2 ኃይል አይደለም።

wrong.en: d) 8 $= 2^3$ counts ALL subsets; we must remove the set itself.
wrong.am: d) 8 $= 2^3$ ሁሉንም ንዑስ ስብስቦች ይቆጥራል፤ ራሱን ስብስቡን ማስወገድ አለብን።

mistake.en: Forgetting the "$- 1$" for proper subsets.
mistake.am: ለትክክለኛ ንዑስ ስብስቦች "$- 1$"ን መርሳት።

explanation.en: Equivalent sets: the same NUMBER of elements (3), but different elements.
explanation.am: ተመጣጣኝ ስብስቦች፦ እኩል የአባላት ቁጥር (3)፣ ግን የተለያዩ አባላት።

text.en: Count: both have 3 elements.
Compare: 1, 2, 3 are not a, b, c → not equal, but equivalent.
text.am: አወዳድሩ፦ 1፣ 2፣ 3 a፣ b፣ c አይደሉም → እኩል አይደሉም፣ ግን ተመጣጣኝ ናቸው።

rule.en: Equal sets: exactly the same elements. Equivalent sets: the same number of elements, $n(A) = n(B)$.
rule.am: እኩል ስብስቦች፦ በትክክል አንድ ዓይነት አባላት። ተመጣጣኝ ስብስቦች፦ እኩል የአባላት ቁጥር፣ $n(A) = n(B)$።

wrong.en: a) Equal sets: 1 is not a, so the elements are different.
wrong.am: a) እኩል ስብስቦች፦ 1 a አይደለም፤ ስለዚህ አባላቱ የተለያዩ ናቸው።

wrong.en: c) Empty sets: both have 3 elements.
wrong.am: c) ባዶ ስብስቦች፦ ሁለቱም 3 አባላት አሏቸው።

wrong.en: d) Infinite sets: both stop after 3 elements.
wrong.am: d) ወሰን የሌላቸው ስብስቦች፦ ሁለቱም ከ3 አባላት በኋላ ይቆማሉ።

mistake.en: Mixing up equal (same elements) and equivalent (same count).
mistake.am: እኩል (አንድ ዓይነት አባላት) እና ተመጣጣኝ (እኩል ቁጥር)ን ማደባለቅ።

question.en: $A \cap B$ is the set of elements that are:
question.am: $A \cap B$ የሚከተሉት አባላት ስብስብ ነው፦

options.en: in A but not in B

explanation.en: $A \cap B$ = the elements in BOTH A and B.
explanation.am: $A \cap B$ = በA እና በB ሁለቱም ያሉ አባላት።

text.en: $\cap$ = AND: an element must be in A and also in B.
text.am: $\cap$ = እና፦ አባሉ በA ውስጥም በB ውስጥም መሆን አለበት።

rule.en: Intersection = AND: keep only what is in both sets. $\cap$ looks like a cap over the shared part.
rule.am: መገናኛ = እና፦ በሁለቱም ስብስቦች ያለውን ብቻ ያዙ። $\cap$ በጋራው ክፍል ላይ ያለ ቆብ ይመስላል።

wrong.en: a) "in A or B" is the union $A \cup B$.
wrong.am: a) "በA ወይም በB" ውህደቱ $A \cup B$ ነው።

wrong.en: c) "in A but not in B" is the difference $A \setminus B$.
wrong.am: c) "በA ያለ ግን በB የሌለ" ልዩነቱ $A \setminus B$ ነው።

wrong.en: d) "in neither A nor B" is $(A \cup B)'$.
wrong.am: d) "በA ወይም በB የሌለ" $(A \cup B)'$ ነው።

mistake.en: Mixing up $\cap$ (AND, both) with $\cup$ (OR, either).
mistake.am: $\cap$ን (እና፣ ሁለቱም) ከ$\cup$ (ወይም፣ አንዱም) ጋር ማደባለቅ።

explanation.en: $A' = \{2, 4\}$: what is in U but not in A.
explanation.am: $A' = \{2, 4\}$፦ በU ያለ ግን በA የሌለ።

text.en: Cross out 1, 3, 5 (they are in A) → $A' = \{2, 4\}$

rule.en: Complement: $A' = U \setminus A$ → start with U and cross out the elements of A.
rule.am: ማሟያ፦ $A' = U \setminus A$ → በU ጀምሩና የAን አባላት ሰርዙ።

wrong.en: b) $\{1, 3, 5\}$ is A itself.
c) $\{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}$ is U: nothing was removed.
wrong.am: c) $\{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}$ U ነው፦ ምንም አልተወገደም።

wrong.en: d) $\emptyset$: 2 and 4 are left over, so it is not empty.
wrong.am: d) $\emptyset$፦ 2 እና 4 ይቀራሉ፤ ስለዚህ ባዶ አይደለም።

mistake.en: Writing A instead of what is OUTSIDE A.
mistake.am: ከA ውጭ ያለውን ፈንታ Aን መጻፍ።

question.en: If $A = \{1,2,3,4\}$ and $B = \{3,4,5\}$, then $A \setminus B$ is:

explanation.en: $A \setminus B = \{1, 2\}$: cross 3 and 4 out of A.
explanation.am: $A \setminus B = \{1, 2\}$፦ 3 እና 4ን ከA ሰርዙ።

text.en: Start with $A = \{1, 2, 3, 4\}$.
3 and 4 are also in B → cross them out → $\{1, 2\}$

rule.en: Difference: $A \setminus B$ = start with A and cross out what is also in B.
rule.am: ልዩነት፦ $A \setminus B$ = በA ጀምሩና በBም ያለውን ሰርዙ።

wrong.en: a) $\{5\}$ is $B \setminus A$ (wrong direction).
wrong.am: a) $\{5\}$ $B \setminus A$ ነው (የተሳሳተ አቅጣጫ)።

wrong.en: b) $\{3, 4\}$ is $A \cap B$: the part we had to remove.
wrong.am: b) $\{3, 4\}$ $A \cap B$ ነው፦ ማስወገድ የነበረብን ክፍል።

mistake.en: Starting from B. In $A \setminus B$ we always start from the FIRST set, A.
mistake.am: ከB መጀመር። በ$A \setminus B$ ሁልጊዜ ከመጀመሪያው ስብስብ፣ ከA እንጀምራለን።

explanation.en: $A \,\Delta\, B = \{1, 2, 5\}$: the elements in ONE set only.
explanation.am: $A \,\Delta\, B = \{1, 2, 5\}$፦ በአንዱ ስብስብ ብቻ ያሉ አባላት።

text.en: In both: 3 and 4 → not in the answer.

rule.en: Symmetric difference: $A \,\Delta\, B = (A \setminus B) \cup (B \setminus A)$ = "A only" together with "B only".
rule.am: ሲሜትሪክ ልዩነት፦ $A \,\Delta\, B = (A \setminus B) \cup (B \setminus A)$ = "A ብቻ" ከ"B ብቻ" ጋር።

wrong.en: a) $\{3, 4\}$ is $A \cap B$: exactly the part that must be removed.
wrong.am: a) $\{3, 4\}$ $A \cap B$ ነው፦ በትክክል መወገድ ያለበት ክፍል።

wrong.en: c) $\{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}$ is $A \cup B$: it still has 3 and 4.
wrong.am: c) $\{1, 2, 3, 4, 5\}$ $A \cup B$ ነው፦ አሁንም 3 እና 4 አሉት።

wrong.en: d) $\{1, 2\}$ is only $A \setminus B$: 5 (B only) is missing.
wrong.am: d) $\{1, 2\}$ $A \setminus B$ ብቻ ነው፦ 5 (B ብቻ) ጎድሏል።

mistake.en: Writing the union. $\Delta$ removes the common elements.
mistake.am: ውህደቱን መጻፍ። $\Delta$ የጋራ አባላትን ያስወግዳል።

question.en: Which is De Morgan's law?
question.am: የደ ሞርጋን ሕግ የትኛው ነው?

explanation.en: $(A \cup B)' = A' \cap B'$: the prime goes inside and flips $\cup$ to $\cap$.
explanation.am: $(A \cup B)' = A' \cap B'$፦ ፕራይሙ ወደ ውስጥ ይገባልና $\cup$ን ወደ $\cap$ ይገለብጣል።

text.en: The prime goes on EACH set: $(A \cup B)' \to A' \;?\; B'$
text.am: ፕራይሙ በእያንዳንዱ ስብስብ ላይ ይቀመጣል፦ $(A \cup B)' \to A' \;?\; B'$

text.en: The sign flips: $\cup$ becomes $\cap$ → $A' \cap B'$

rule.en: De Morgan's law: "not in (A or B)" = "not in A AND not in B". In symbols: $(A \cup B)' = A' \cap B'$.
rule.am: የደ ሞርጋን ሕግ፦ "በ(A ወይም B) ውስጥ የሌለ" = "በA የሌለ እና በB የሌለ"። በምልክት፦ $(A \cup B)' = A' \cap B'$።

wrong.en: a) $(A \cup B)' = A' \cup B'$: the sign did not flip.
wrong.am: a) $(A \cup B)' = A' \cup B'$፦ ምልክቱ አልተገለበጠም።

wrong.en: c) $(A \cap B)' = A' \cap B'$: the sign did not flip here either; it should be $A' \cup B'$.
wrong.am: c) $(A \cap B)' = A' \cap B'$፦ እዚህም ምልክቱ አልተገለበጠም፤ $A' \cup B'$ መሆን ነበረበት።

wrong.en: d) $(A')' = A'$: taking the complement twice gives back A.
wrong.am: d) $(A')' = A'$፦ ማሟያን ሁለት ጊዜ መውሰድ Aን ይመልሳል።

mistake.en: Putting the prime on each set but forgetting to flip the sign.
mistake.am: ፕራይሙን በእያንዳንዱ ስብስብ ላይ አድርጎ ምልክቱን መገልበጥ መርሳት።

question.en: $A \cup (B \cap C)$ is equal to:
question.am: $A \cup (B \cap C)$ እኩል ነው ከ፦

explanation.en: $A \cup (B \cap C) = (A \cup B) \cap (A \cup C)$: the distributive law.
explanation.am: $A \cup (B \cap C) = (A \cup B) \cap (A \cup C)$፦ የማከፋፈል ሕግ።

text.en: Share "$A \cup$" into each bracket: $(A \cup B)$ and $(A \cup C)$.
text.am: "$A \cup$"ን ወደ እያንዳንዱ ቅንፍ አከፋፍሉ፦ $(A \cup B)$ እና $(A \cup C)$።

text.en: Keep $\cap$ between them: $(A \cup B) \cap (A \cup C)$

rule.en: Distributive law: the outside "$A \cup$" is shared into each bracket, and the sign in the middle ($\cap$) stays between the brackets.
rule.am: የማከፋፈል ሕግ፦ የውጭው "$A \cup$" ወደ እያንዳንዱ ቅንፍ ይከፋፈላል፤ በመሃል ያለው ምልክት ($\cap$) በቅንፎቹ መካከል ይቀራል።

wrong.en: b) $(A \cap B) \cup (A \cap C)$ is the OTHER distributive law, for $A \cap (B \cup C)$.
wrong.am: b) $(A \cap B) \cup (A \cap C)$ ሌላው የማከፋፈል ሕግ ነው፤ ለ$A \cap (B \cup C)$።

wrong.en: c) $(A \cup B) \cup C$ changed the $\cap$ into $\cup$.
wrong.am: c) $(A \cup B) \cup C$ $\cap$ን ወደ $\cup$ ቀይሮታል።

wrong.en: d) $A \cap B \cap C$ lost the union completely.
wrong.am: d) $A \cap B \cap C$ ውህደቱን ሙሉ በሙሉ አጥፍቷል።

mistake.en: Swapping the signs. Copy the outside sign into each bracket; keep the middle sign between them.
mistake.am: ምልክቶቹን ማቀያየር። የውጭውን ምልክት ወደ እያንዳንዱ ቅንፍ ቅዱ፤ የመሃሉን ምልክት በመካከላቸው አቆዩ።

question.en: $A \cap A'$ is equal to:
question.am: $A \cap A'$ እኩል ነው ከ፦

explanation.en: $A \cap A' = \emptyset$: nothing is in A and outside A at the same time.
explanation.am: $A \cap A' = \emptyset$፦ ምንም ነገር በአንድ ጊዜ በA ውስጥና ከA ውጭ አይሆንም።

text.en: An element would need to be in A AND not in A. Impossible → $\emptyset$
text.am: አንድ አባል በA ውስጥ እና በA ውጭ መሆን ያስፈልገዋል። የማይቻል ነው → $\emptyset$

rule.en: Complement law: $A \cap A' = \emptyset$ and $A \cup A' = U$.
rule.am: የማሟያ ሕግ፦ $A \cap A' = \emptyset$ እና $A \cup A' = U$።

wrong.en: a) $A$: the elements of A are not in $A'$, so they can't be in the intersection.
wrong.am: a) $A$፦ የA አባላት በ$A'$ ውስጥ የሉም፤ ስለዚህ በመገናኛው ውስጥ ሊሆኑ አይችሉም።

wrong.en: b) $U$ is $A \cup A'$, the union, not the intersection.
wrong.am: b) $U$ $A \cup A'$፣ ውህደቱ ነው እንጂ መገናኛው አይደለም።

wrong.en: d) $A'$: the elements of $A'$ are not in A.
wrong.am: d) $A'$፦ የ$A'$ አባላት በA ውስጥ የሉም።

mistake.en: Mixing up the two complement laws: $\cap$ gives $\emptyset$, $\cup$ gives $U$.
mistake.am: ሁለቱን የማሟያ ሕጎች ማደባለቅ፦ $\cap$ $\emptyset$ን፣ $\cup$ $U$ን ይሰጣል።

question.en: $A \setminus B$ is the same as:
question.am: $A \setminus B$ ተመሳሳይ ነው ከ፦

explanation.en: $A \setminus B = A \cap B'$: "in A" AND "not in B".
explanation.am: $A \setminus B = A \cap B'$፦ "በA ውስጥ" እና "በB ውስጥ ያልሆነ"።

text.en: $A \setminus B$ in words: "in A, but not in B".
text.am: $A \setminus B$ በቃላት፦ "በA ውስጥ፣ ግን በB ውስጥ ያልሆነ"።

text.en: "not in B" = "in $B'$", and "but" = AND → $A \cap B'$

rule.en: Difference rule: $A \setminus B = A \cap B'$. "Not in B" means "in $B'$", and "but" means AND.
rule.am: የልዩነት ደንብ፦ $A \setminus B = A \cap B'$። "በB የሌለ" ማለት "በ$B'$ ያለ" ነው፤ "ግን" ደግሞ "እና" ማለት ነው።

wrong.en: a) $A \cap B$ keeps the elements that ARE in B: the opposite.
wrong.am: a) $A \cap B$ በB ያሉትን አባላት ይይዛል፦ ተቃራኒው ነው።

wrong.en: b) $A \cup B'$ also adds everything outside B, even if it is not in A.
wrong.am: b) $A \cup B'$ ከB ውጭ ያለውን ሁሉ ይጨምራል፤ በA ውስጥ ባይሆንም።

wrong.en: d) $B \cap A'$ is $B \setminus A$: the wrong direction.
wrong.am: d) $B \cap A'$ $B \setminus A$ ነው፦ የተሳሳተ አቅጣጫ።

mistake.en: Using $\cup$. "In A but not in B" needs BOTH conditions, so it is $\cap$.
mistake.am: $\cup$ን መጠቀም። "በA ያለ ግን በB የሌለ" ሁለቱንም ሁኔታዎች ይፈልጋል፤ ስለዚህ $\cap$ ነው።

question.en: If $n(A) = 12$, $n(B) = 9$ and $n(A \cap B) = 4$, then $n(A \cup B)$ is:
question.am: $n(A) = 12$፣ $n(B) = 9$ እና $n(A \cap B) = 4$ ከሆኑ $n(A \cup B)$፦

text.en: Formula: $n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$
text.am: ቀመር፦ $n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$

rule.en: $n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$: the shared elements were counted twice, so subtract them once.
rule.am: $n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$፦ የጋራ አባላት ሁለት ጊዜ ተቆጥረዋል፤ ስለዚህ አንድ ጊዜ ቀንሷቸው።

wrong.en: a) 21 $= 12 + 9$: the 4 shared elements are counted twice.
wrong.am: a) 21 $= 12 + 9$፦ 4ቱ የጋራ አባላት ሁለት ጊዜ ተቆጥረዋል።

wrong.en: c) 25 $= 12 + 9 + 4$: the shared part should be subtracted, not added.
wrong.am: c) 25 $= 12 + 9 + 4$፦ የጋራው ክፍል መቀነስ እንጂ መደመር የለበትም።

wrong.en: d) 13 $= 12 + 9 - 2 \times 4$ is $n(A \,\Delta\, B)$.
wrong.am: d) 13 $= 12 + 9 - 2 \times 4$ $n(A \,\Delta\, B)$ ነው።

mistake.en: Just adding the two numbers and forgetting the overlap.
mistake.am: ሁለቱን ቁጥሮች ብቻ መደመርና መደራረቢያውን መርሳት።

question.en: $\{x \in \mathbb{R} \mid x^2 = 4\}$ is:
question.am: $\{x \in \mathbb{R} \mid x^2 = 4\}$ is:

text.en: $2 \times 2 = 4$ ✓ → $2$ is a solution

rule.en: $x^2 = 4$ has TWO real solutions: $x = 2$ and $x = -2$, because a negative times a negative is positive.
rule.am: $x^2 = 4$ ሁለት እውነተኛ መፍትሔዎች አሉት፦ $x = 2$ እና $x = -2$፤ ምክንያቱም አሉታዊ ሲባዛ በአሉታዊ አዎንታዊ ይሆናል።

wrong.en: d) $\emptyset$: there ARE real solutions.
wrong.am: d) $\emptyset$፦ እውነተኛ መፍትሔዎች አሉ።

mistake.en: Forgetting the negative square root.
mistake.am: አሉታዊውን ካሬ ሥር መርሳት።

question.en: $\{x \in \mathbb{Z} \mid -2 < x \le 2\}$ is:
question.am: $\{x \in \mathbb{Z} \mid -2 < x \le 2\}$ is:

text.en: Left end: $-2 < x$ → $-2$ is NOT included; start at $-1$.
text.am: የግራ ጫፍ፦ $-2 < x$ → $-2$ አይካተትም፤ ከ$-1$ ጀምሩ።

text.en: Right end: $x \le 2$ → 2 IS included → $\{-1, 0, 1, 2\}$

rule.en: $<$: the end is NOT included. $\le$: the end IS included.
rule.am: $<$፦ ጫፉ አይካተትም። $\le$፦ ጫፉ ይካተታል።

wrong.en: a) $\{-2, -1, 0, 1, 2\}$ includes $-2$, but $-2 < x$ means $x$ is bigger than $-2$.
c) $\{-1, 0, 1\}$ leaves out 2, but $\le 2$ includes 2.
wrong.am: c) $\{-1, 0, 1\}$ 2ን ያስቀራል፤ $\le 2$ ግን 2ን ያካትታል።

wrong.en: d) $\{0, 1, 2\}$ forgets $-1$, which is an integer bigger than $-2$.
wrong.am: d) $\{0, 1, 2\}$ $-1$ን ይረሳል፤ እሱ ከ$-2$ የሚበልጥ ኢንቲጀር ነው።

mistake.en: Treating $<$ like $\le$. Check each end separately.
mistake.am: $<$ን እንደ $\le$ መቁጠር። እያንዳንዱን ጫፍ ለየብቻ ፈትሹ።

explanation.en: $A \cap B \cap C = \{7\}$: 7 is the only number in all three circles.
explanation.am: $A \cap B \cap C = \{7\}$፦ በሦስቱም ክበቦች ያለው ቁጥር 7 ብቻ ነው።

text.en: First two: $A \cap B = \{5, 7\}$
Check C = {3, 4, 6, 7}: 5 is not in C ✗, 7 is ✓ → $\{7\}$

rule.en: Intersection of three sets: the number must be in A AND in B AND in C (the centre region).
rule.am: የሦስት ስብስቦች መገናኛ፦ ቁጥሩ በA እና በB እና በC ውስጥ መሆን አለበት (የመሃሉ ክፍል)።

wrong.en: b) $\{5, 7\}$ is only $A \cap B$: 5 is not in C.
wrong.am: b) $\{5, 7\}$ $A \cap B$ ብቻ ነው፦ 5 በC ውስጥ የለም።

wrong.en: c) $\{4, 6, 7\}$: 4 is not in B and 6 is not in A.
wrong.am: c) $\{4, 6, 7\}$፦ 4 በB ውስጥ የለም፣ 6 ደግሞ በA ውስጥ የለም።

wrong.en: d) $\emptyset$: 7 is in all three, so it is not empty.
wrong.am: d) $\emptyset$፦ 7 በሦስቱም ውስጥ ስላለ ባዶ አይደለም።

mistake.en: Stopping after $A \cap B$ and forgetting to check C.
mistake.am: ከ$A \cap B$ በኋላ ቆሞ Cን ማረጋገጥ መርሳት።

question.en: In a class of 30, 18 study Math, 15 study English and 5 study both. How many study neither?
question.am: 30 ተማሪዎች ባሉበት ክፍል 18ቱ ሒሳብ፣ 15ቱ እንግሊዝኛ፣ 5ቱ ሁለቱንም ያጠናሉ። ስንቶቹ ምንም አያጠኑም?

explanation.en: 2 students: $18 + 15 - 5 = 28$ study at least one, and $30 - 28 = 2$.
explanation.am: 2 ተማሪዎች፦ $18 + 15 - 5 = 28$ ቢያንስ አንዱን ያጠናሉ፤ $30 - 28 = 2$።

text.en: At least one: $18 + 15 - 5 = 28$
Neither: $30 - 28 = 2$

rule.en: Neither $= n(U) - n(M \cup E)$, with $n(M \cup E) = n(M) + n(E) - n(M \cap E)$.
rule.am: አንዳቸውም $= n(U) - n(M \cup E)$፣ $n(M \cup E) = n(M) + n(E) - n(M \cap E)$።

wrong.en: b) 3: no rule gives 3.
wrong.am: b) 3፦ ምንም ደንብ 3ን አይሰጥም።

wrong.en: c) 7 $= 30 - 18 - 5$: ignores English.
wrong.am: c) 7 $= 30 - 18 - 5$፦ እንግሊዝኛን ችላ ይላል።

wrong.en: d) 12 $= 30 - 18$: ignores English and the overlap.
wrong.am: d) 12 $= 30 - 18$፦ እንግሊዝኛንና መደራረቢያውን ችላ ይላል።

mistake.en: Subtracting $18 + 15 = 33$ from 30. The 5 who study both were counted twice.
mistake.am: $18 + 15 = 33$ን ከ30 መቀነስ። ሁለቱንም የሚያጠኑት 5 ሁለት ጊዜ ተቆጥረዋል።

explanation.en: $A \cap B = \{4, 5\}$: the elements in both sets.
explanation.am: $A \cap B = \{4, 5\}$፦ በሁለቱም ስብስቦች ያሉ አባላት።

text.en: Go through A: 1, 2, 3 are not in B ✗
4 and 5 are in B ✓ → $\{4, 5\}$

rule.en: Intersection: keep only what is in both sets.
rule.am: መገናኛ፦ በሁለቱም ስብስቦች ያለውን ብቻ ያዙ።

mistake.en: Writing the union $\{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6\}$.

rule.en: Complement: $A' = U \setminus A$, start with U and cross out the elements of A.
rule.am: ማሟያ፦ $A' = U \setminus A$፣ በU ጀምሩና የAን አባላት ሰርዙ።

mistake.en: Writing A itself.
mistake.am: ራሱን Aን መጻፍ።

question.en: Write $\{x \in \mathbb{Z} \mid x^2 = 9\}$ by complete listing.
question.am: $\{x \in \mathbb{Z} \mid x^2 = 9\}$ን በሙሉ ዝርዝር ጻፉ።

text.en: Both are integers → $\{-3, 3\}$

rule.en: $x^2 = 9$ has two solutions: $x = 3$ and $x = -3$. Both are integers.
rule.am: $x^2 = 9$ ሁለት መፍትሔዎች አሉት፦ $x = 3$ እና $x = -3$። ሁለቱም ኢንቲጀሮች ናቸው።

mistake.en: Writing only $\{3\}$ and forgetting $-3$.
mistake.am: $\{3\}$ን ብቻ መጻፍና $-3$ን መርሳት።

question.en: If $n(A) = 15$, $n(B) = 10$ and $n(A \cup B) = 20$, find $n(A \cap B)$.
question.am: $n(A) = 15$፣ $n(B) = 10$ እና $n(A \cup B) = 20$ ከሆኑ $n(A \cap B)$ን ፈልጉ።

rule.en: $n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$. Put in what you know, then solve for the unknown.
rule.am: $n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$። የምታውቁትን አስገቡ፣ ከዚያ ያልታወቀውን ፍቱ።

mistake.en: Doing $20 - 15 = 5$ by luck without the formula. Always write the formula first.
mistake.am: ያለ ቀመሩ በዕድል $20 - 15 = 5$ ማድረግ። ሁልጊዜ መጀመሪያ ቀመሩን ጻፉ።

question.en: How many subsets does a set with 5 elements have?
question.am: 5 አባላት ያሉት ስብስብ ስንት ንዑስ ስብስቦች አሉት?

explanation.en: $2^5 = 32$ subsets.
explanation.am: $2^5 = 32$ ንዑስ ስብስቦች።

text.en: Subsets $= 2^n$ with $n = 5$.
$2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 = 32$

rule.en: Each of the $n$ elements is "in" or "out": $2^n$ subsets.
rule.am: ከ$n$ አባላት እያንዳንዱ "ውስጥ" ወይም "ውጭ" ነው፦ $2^n$ ንዑስ ስብስቦች።

mistake.en: Writing $2 \times 5 = 10$.
mistake.am: $2 \times 5 = 10$ ብሎ መጻፍ።

question.en: Shade $(A \cup B)'$.
question.am: $(A \cup B)'$ን አጥሉ።

explanation.en: $(A \cup B)'$ is everything OUTSIDE both circles.
explanation.am: $(A \cup B)'$ ከሁለቱም ክበቦች ውጭ ያለው ሁሉ ነው።

text.en: Step 1: $A \cup B$ = both circles.
Step 2: the complement = only the part outside both circles.
text.am: ደረጃ 2፦ ማሟያው = ከሁለቱም ክበቦች ውጭ ያለው ክፍል ብቻ።

rule.en: Bracket first, then the complement: $(A \cup B)'$ = in U but not in $A \cup B$.
rule.am: መጀመሪያ ቅንፉ፣ ከዚያ ማሟያው፦ $(A \cup B)'$ = በU ያለ ግን በ$A \cup B$ የሌለ።

mistake.en: Shading the circles themselves. The prime means: shade what is OUTSIDE them.
mistake.am: ክበቦቹን ራሳቸውን ማጥለል። ፕራይሙ ማለት፦ ከእነሱ ውጭ ያለውን አጥሉ።

question.en: Shade $A \cap B'$.
question.am: $A \cap B'$ን አጥሉ።

explanation.en: $A \cap B' = A \setminus B$: the part of A outside B.
explanation.am: $A \cap B' = A \setminus B$፦ ከB ውጭ ያለው የA ክፍል።

text.en: Step 1: $B'$ = everything outside circle B.
text.am: ደረጃ 1፦ $B'$ = ከክበብ B ውጭ ያለው ሁሉ።

text.en: Step 2: keep only the part inside A → A's own part (no overlap).
text.am: ደረጃ 2፦ በA ውስጥ ያለውን ክፍል ብቻ ያዙ → የA የራሱ ክፍል (መደራረቢያ የለም)።

rule.en: $B'$ = everything outside B. "$A \cap$" = stay inside A. Together: inside A AND outside B.
rule.am: $B'$ = ከB ውጭ ያለው ሁሉ። "$A \cap$" = በA ውስጥ ቆዩ። አንድ ላይ፦ በA ውስጥ እና ከB ውጭ።

mistake.en: Also shading the outside region. It is outside B, but not inside A.
mistake.am: የውጭውን ክፍልም ማጥለል። ከB ውጭ ነው፤ በA ውስጥ ግን አይደለም።

question.en: Shade $(A \cap B) \cup C$.
question.am: $(A \cap B) \cup C$ን አጥሉ።

explanation.en: All of circle C, plus the lens where A and B overlap.
explanation.am: ሙሉው ክበብ C፣ እንዲሁም A እና B የሚደራረቡበት ሌንስ።

text.en: Step 1: $A \cap B$ = the lens between A and B (2 regions).
text.am: ደረጃ 1፦ $A \cap B$ = በA እና በB መካከል ያለው ሌንስ (2 ክፍሎች)።

text.en: Step 2: add all of C (4 regions). One region (the centre) is in both, so count it once → 5 regions.
text.am: ደረጃ 2፦ ሙሉውን C ጨምሩ (4 ክፍሎች)። አንድ ክፍል (መሃሉ) በሁለቱም ውስጥ ነው፤ አንድ ጊዜ ቁጠሩት → 5 ክፍሎች።

rule.en: Bracket first: $A \cap B$ is the lens between A and B. Then "$\cup C$" adds all of circle C.
rule.am: መጀመሪያ ቅንፉ፦ $A \cap B$ በA እና በB መካከል ያለው ሌንስ ነው። ከዚያ "$\cup C$" ሙሉውን ክበብ C ይጨምራል።

mistake.en: Shading only $A \cap B \cap C$ (the centre). The union adds ALL of C.
mistake.am: $A \cap B \cap C$ን (መሃሉን) ብቻ ማጥለል። ውህደቱ ሙሉውን C ይጨምራል።
